name: .alpha.-tocopherol + hydrated silica + sodium monofluorophosphate
uses: Uses ■ Keeps teeth white and strong. ■ Keeps the oral cavity clean. ■ Refreshes the oral cavity. ■ Prevents cavities by fluoride and removes bad breath. ■ Enhances the aesthetic effect. ■ Helps prevent gingivitis, periodontitis (pyorrhea), periodontal disease, and gum disease. ■ Prevention of tartar deposition. ■ Removes dental plaque (anti-plaque).
otcwarn: Warnings ■ This toothpaste contains 1,000 ppm fluoride. ■ Stop use and ask a doctor or dentist if irritation or other adverse reactions occur in the gums or mouth. ■ If more than the amount used for brushing is accidentally swallowed by a child under 6 years of age, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. ■ Do not swallow. Rinse mouth thoroughly after brushing. ■ Children under 6 years of age should use only a pea-sized amount under adult supervision to minimize swallowing. ■ Keep out of reach of children under 6 years of age

src.label: ROROBELL WAWA Kids Tooth Natural Green Grape Flavor
